mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_candidate (id, task_id, row_no, raw_payload, normalized_payload, confidence, warnings, review_status, version) values (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{rowNo}, cast(#{rawPayload} as jsonb), cast(#{normalizedPayload} as jsonb), #{confidence}, cast(#{warnings} as jsonb), #{reviewStatus}, #{version})
mapper.select: select id, task_id, row_no, normalized_payload::text as normalized_payload, review_status, version, confidence, warnings::text as warnings from cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_candidate where task_id = #{taskId} and deleted_at is null order by row_no, id
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_candidate set normalized_payload = cast(#{normalizedPayload} as jsonb), version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{candidateId} and task_id = #{taskId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and review_status = 'PENDING' and deleted_at is null

update cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_import_candidate set review_status = 'ACCEPTED', version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{candidateId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and review_status = 'PENDING' and deleted_at is null
